--- Page 1 (Beckerman_90a) --- 2 AUGUST DEAR FOLKS: RECEIVED TWO MORE LETTERS FROM MOMA, BOTH OF WHICH I WAS ABLE TO READ VERY EASILY. HAVE ALSO BEEN RECEIVING SEVERAL LETTERS FROM RUTH. BY NOW YOU PROBABLY HAVE HEARD FROM ABE THAT WE MET MAX HANDLER HERE IN MANILA. IT WAS GOOD TO SEE HIM AGAIN AND WE GET TOGETHER SEVERAL TIMES EACH WEEK TO TALK ABOUT THIS AND THAT. WE ALSO RAN INTO THE SON OF WEBER, THE FAMILY THAT USED TO LIVE NEXT DOOR TO US IN W-1. I HARDLY RECOGNIZED THE WEBER BOY. HE HAD GROWN ABOUT A FOOT SINCE I LAST SAW HIM.. SO WE HAVE QUITE BE A CROWD OF NEIGHBORHOOD BOYS HERE. AND WE'LL PROBABLY/RUNNING INTO MORE OF THEM AS TIME GOES BY. MAYBE LOOKS JUST ABOUT THE SAME AS ALWAYS, XXREM EXCEPT A BIT HUSKIER. HE HAD MUCH NEWS FOR US ABOUT OUR OLD FRIENDS. I RECEIVED YOUR LETTER ABOUT THE PICTURES I SENT YOU. YOU WILL BE RECEIVING MORE OF THEM IN THE MAIL VERY SHORTLY.
